stories.h: Sheriff Swank posts woman's address, sparks backlash
stories.s: Sheriff Keith Swank posted a Tacoma woman's address online and accused her of stalking. X briefly locked his account, and prosecutors say they received only one threat referral, not the two he claimed.

stories.h: Arrest after machete attack in South Hill parking lot
stories.s: Deputies arrested a 54-year-old man for first-degree assault after a man was badly cut in a machete attack near 160th St. E and Meridian. Deputies gave aid until medics arrived.

stories.h: Frisko Freeze owner's Tacoma restaurant group to dissolve
stories.s: X Group Restaurants is selling Asado, E9 Firehouse and E9 Brewing to new local owners and will then dissolve. Frisko Freeze stays open under the Xitco family.

coming.h: Thanksgiving king tides threaten Puget Sound shorelines
coming.s: Forecasters say the coastal flood risk moves to inland waters, including Puget Sound, on Thanksgiving. Waterfront roads and low-lying neighborhoods could flood, with 30 to 40 mph gusts in the South Sound.

coming.h: I-5 Lacey–Tacoma congestion through holiday weekend
coming.s: WSDOT's travel charts for Nov. 25 to 29 flag I-5 between Lacey and Tacoma as a main bottleneck. SR 167 express lanes are free on Thanksgiving.
